# The builtins that had no throw decision when the rule was introduced: in neither
# MAY_THROW_LIB_FNS (builtin-effects.ts) nor NEVER_THROW_LIB_FNS (builtin-never-throw.ts).
# They are compiled as non-throwing. To decide one, read its runtime function and add the
# builtin to one of the two sets; the row overrides its line here.
# Do not edit this file: packages/compiler/test/builtin-attributes.test.ts pins its digest.
# A new builtin goes into one of the two sets, never into this list.
